title: Injection of toric boundary divisor classes into the complete local class group
statement:
Let $P$ be a finitely generated integral saturated commutative monoid [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], written additively, and suppose it is sharp, meaning that $0$ is its only invertible element. Let $n\geq0$ be an integer. For a coefficient ring $L$, write $L[P][t_1,\ldots,t_n]$ for the ring of finite sums of symbols $c z^q t^e$, with $q\in P$, $e\in\mathbf N^n$, $c\in L$, and multiplication $z^qz^{q'}=z^{q+q'}$. If $L$ is local with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_L$, let $B_L(P,n)$ be its completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] at $(\mathfrak m_L,z^q\ (q
eq0),t_1,\ldots,t_n)$. Let $R$ be one of the following rings: (i) $B_k(P,n)$ for a field $k$; (ii) $B_C(P,n)/(	heta)$ for a Cohen ring $C$ of residue characteristic $p$ [def-weil-pbc-cohen-ring] and $	heta-p\in(z^q\ (q
eq0),t_1,\ldots,t_n)B_C(P,n)$. In case (ii), $p$ is prime and the residue field of $C$ is arbitrary of characteristic $p$. Write $z^q$ for the chart monomials in $R$. Assume that $R$ is a Noetherian normal domain [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-normal-ring] and all $z^q$ are nonzero. Put $G=P^{m gp}$ and let $\sigma\subset G\otimes_{\mathbf Z}\mathbf Q$ be the cone of nonnegative rational combinations of $P$. Let $\mathcal F$ be its finite set of codimension-one faces. For $F\in\mathcal F$ let $
u_F:G	o\mathbf Z$ be the primitive nonnegative facet form: its image is $\mathbf Z$, it is nonnegative on $P$, and $F=\sigma\cap\ker
u_F$. Put $\mathfrak p_F=(z^q:q\in P,\ q
otin F)R$. Assume these are distinct height-one primes and that the normalized valuation at $R_{\mathfrak p_F}$ takes $z^q$ to $
u_F(q)$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime, def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring]. A height-one prime is a nonzero prime with no prime strictly between it and $(0)$. Define $\operatorname{Div}(R)= igoplus_{\operatorname{ht}\mathfrak q=1}\mathbf Z[\mathfrak q]$. For $b\in\operatorname{Frac}(R)^	imes$ write $\operatorname{div}_R(b)=\sum_{\operatorname{ht}\mathfrak q=1}v_{\mathfrak q}(b)[\mathfrak q]$, where $v_{\mathfrak q}$ is the normalized additive valuation of the discrete valuation ring $R_{\mathfrak q}$; this sum has finite support. Let $\operatorname{Cl}(R)$ be $\operatorname{Div}(R)$ modulo the subgroup of all such principal divisors. Put
$$
u:G\longrightarrow\mathbf Z^{\mathcal F},\qquad g\longmapsto(
u_F(g))_F.$$
Assume the height-one primes meeting $\{z^q:q\in P\}$ are exactly the $\mathfrak p_F$. Then the homomorphism
$$ eta:\mathbf Z^{\mathcal F}/
u(G)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Cl}(R),\qquad [(m_F)_F]\longmapsto\left[\sum_Fm_F[\mathfrak p_F]ight]$$
is well defined and injective. In particular this asserts injectivity on all integer boundary-divisor classes, not surjectivity onto $\operatorname{Cl}(R)$. It includes $P=\{0\}$, when its domain is zero. Here $\operatorname{Cl}(R)$ is the Weil divisor class group, not the group of invertible fractional ideals modulo principal ideals.

u(G)$ and descends to $ eta$. If $P=\{0\}$ its source is zero. Assume henceforth $P

proof.text:
Let $[(m_F)]\in\ker eta$. A finite sum $\sum_j n_j\operatorname{div}(f_j)$ of principal generators equals $\operatorname{div}(\prod_j f_j^{n_j})$, since valuations are additive and $f_j
e0$; thus the principal subgroup consists of principal divisors. Hence the kernel condition supplies $f\in\operatorname{Frac}(R)^	imes$ with $\operatorname{div}(f)=\sum_Fm_F[\mathfrak p_F]$. Put $	au=z^c
e0$. Its boundary valuations are $
u_F(c)>0$; elsewhere they vanish because monomials avoid the prime. The valuations of $f$ vanish there as well. The ring $R$ is Noetherian and normal by hypothesis, and the boundary list is finite with distinct height-one primes. Thus [lem-trf-normal-boundary-fraction-clearing] applies with $I=\mathcal F$, giving integers $N,H\ge0$, elements $h=fz^{Nc},h'=f^{-1}z^{Hc}\in R$, and $hh'=z^{(N+H)c}$.

proof.text:
In $D$ the last identity is $hh'=X^s$ with $s=(N+H)w\in M\cap\mathbf N^r$. Every $X^a$ for $a\in M\cap\mathbf N^r$ lies in $R$, by $
u(P)=M\cap\mathbf N^r$. The strictly positive $w$ comes from step 2, and $ arho$ fixes $R$. All hypotheses of [lem-trf-lattice-retraction-prime-factor-descent] now hold with $x_i=X_i$ and $ho= arho$. It gives $e\in M\cap\mathbf N^r$ and $u\in R^	imes$ with $h=X^e u$ in $R$. Choose $a_0\in P$ with $
u(a_0)=e$. Then $f=u z^{a_0}/z^{Nc}$. Since $u\in R^	imes$, it and its inverse belong to every $R_{\mathfrak p_F}$, so $v_F(u)=0$. The assumed monomial valuation formula therefore gives $m_F=
u_F(a_0)-N
u_F(c)$. Hence $(m_F)=
u(a_0-Nc)$ and its quotient class is zero. This proves injectivity. The cited cover statements include $n=0$ and both coefficient cases with arbitrary Cohen residue field.
